charts.title: NGTS-35 b: orbits around NGTS-35
charts.description: The orbits of NGTS-35's planets in this map from above, to scale, with NGTS-35 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 731.9966539026 d

charts.title: NGTS-35 b: its transit
charts.description: NGTS-35 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (90, 100, 101) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 333736132, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 4 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 1 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
